title: BigCommerce API: Developer Guide to Custom Integrations
snippet:
- BigCommerce API is included free with all plans. No extra fees for access.
- Standard plans allow [150 requests per 30 seconds](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/overview/api-fundamentals/rate-limits). Pro plans allow 450.

The [BigCommerce Development Services](/bigcommerce-development-services) approach focuses on these core workflows first. Fancy features come later.

Rate limits vary by plan:
| Plan | Requests per 30 Seconds | Best For |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | 150 | Small catalogs, low volume |
| Plus | 150 | Same as Standard |
| Pro | 450 | Growing businesses |
| Enterprise | Varies | Depends on plan and resource |
If you hit limits often, think about upgrading. Pro costs more but gives you [3x the throughput](https://docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/overview/api-fundamentals/rate-limits).

title: docs.bigcommerce.com/developer/docs/overview/api-fundamentals/rate-limits
snippet:
Apps using OAuth are rate-limited based on a quota that's refreshed every 30 seconds. The maximum quota varies by store plan and requested resources.
| Plan Type                              | Quota                                                                                         |
| :------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Performance and Performance-Test       | by plan and [resource](https://support.bigcommerce.com/s/article/Platform-Limits#storelimits) |
| Other sandboxes (Dev/Partner/Employee) | by [resource](https://support.bigcommerce.com/s/article/Platform-Limits#storelimits)          |
| Scale                                  | 60k per hour (450 / 30sec)                                                                    |
| Growth & Core                          | 20k per hour (150 / 30sec)                                                                    |
